fields.System.Title: INT-4 — Operational reporting
fields.System.Description:
Purpose

Give supervisors the four numbers they need to run a shift, and give the team the baseline to
judge whether an optimisation worked.

Scope

In. Open work by zone, throughput by hour, dock-to-stock time, order cycle time.

Out. Business intelligence tooling. Financial reporting. Labour management.

Design notes

Build these before the optimisation work in Stage 4, not after. Waves, batch picking, and
smart putaway are all supposed to make things faster. Without a baseline you cannot tell
whether they did, and "it feels quicker" is how teams ship changes that made things worse.

INT-401 is the one a supervisor uses hourly. Open tasks by zone and by age shows where
the bottleneck is right now. It is the difference between reassigning staff at 10am and finding
out at 4pm that the cut-off was missed.

Keep these to four. A reporting feature that grows to thirty views becomes nobody's job to
maintain, and the ones that matter get lost among the ones that do not.

Risks

| Risk | Reference |
|---|---|
| Optimising without a baseline | [doc 07 §7](../../../docs/07-phased-delivery-plan.md) |
| Reporting queries slowing transactional work | [doc 02 §5](../../../docs/02-architecture-overview.md) |
